title: 5 Signs a Godly Man Judges Himself Harder Than He Judges You
caption:
Most guys flip it. Soft on their own sin, sharp with everyone around them.

A godly man runs it the other way. He's hard on himself so he can be gentle with you.

Five signs: he replays his own mistakes for a week and forgets yours by dinner, he apologizes even when it's only half his fault, he gives you patience he wouldn't give himself, he holds his own sin to Scripture instead of your excuse, and his confession of himself is harsher than his correction of you.

Tag a brother who runs it this way.

theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
